privacy.title: Politiki y'Ibanga
privacy.description: Uko I Need Convert ifata amakuru na dosiye byawe. Dosiye zihindurirwa muri mushakisha yawe kandi ntizigera zoherezwa kuri seriveri zacu.
privacy.body:
I Need Convert (ineedconvert.com) ni igikoresho cy'ubuntu cyo guhindura amafoto, amashusho, amajwi, inyandiko, PDF, spreadsheet n'amakuru, kiyoborwa na Abid Hanan Wicaksono. Iyi politiki isobanura amakuru atunganywa iyo ukoresha uru rubuga n'uburyo tuyafata. Tubigambiriye, dukusanya amakuru make ashoboka: ntukeneye kwiyandikisha, kwinjira, cyangwa gutanga izina ryawe na imeri kugira ngo ukoreshe iyi serivisi.

Dosiye uhindura

Ihindura ryose rikorerwa muri mushakisha yawe ubwayo. Dosiye uhitamo zisomwa kandi zigatunganywa n'igikoresho cyawe ubwacyo, hanyuma ibisubizo bikabikwa ako kanya ku gikoresho cyawe. Dosiye zawe n'ibizikubiyemo ntibigera byoherezwa kuri seriveri zacu, ntitubibika, kandi ntidushobora kubibona. Iyo ufunze cyangwa wongeye gufungura paji, izo dosiye zivanwa mu bubiko bwa mushakisha.

Amakuru dutunganya

  • Amakuru ya tekiniki. Kimwe n'imbuga hafi ya zose, utwakirira urubuga (Cloudflare) abika amakuru ya tekiniki y'ibisabwa, nka aderesi ya IP, ubwoko bwa mushakisha n'igihe winjiriyeho, ku mpamvu z'umutekano n'imikorere. Ayo makuru abikwa by'igihe gito gusa, hakurikijwe politiki ya Cloudflare.
  • Imibare y'inyandiko. Umubare w'abarebye, abakunze n'abasangije ubikwa nk'igiteranyo kuri buri nyandiko, nta makuru akuranga arimo.

Cookies n'ububiko muri mushakisha

  • inc-lang (localStorage): yibuka ururimi wahisemo. Aya makuru aguma ku gikoresho cyawe.
  • Cookies z'isesengura z'ibigo byo hanze za Google Analytics na Microsoft Clarity, zisobanuwe hepfo.
  • Ububiko bwo ku gikoresho (localStorage na sessionStorage): bwibuka inyandiko wakunze kandi bukabuza ko gusura kumwe kubarwa kabiri. Aya makuru aguma ku gikoresho cyawe.

Isesengura

Dukoresha ibikoresho by'isesengura kugira ngo twumve uko urubuga rukoreshwa no kurunoza:

  • Google Analytics 4 (Google LLC): ikoresha cookies mu gupima paji ufungura, igihugu urimo mu buryo bwegereye, ubwoko bw'igikoresho cyawe, n'ibikorwa nko gukanda kuri buto zo gukuramo. Amakuru atunganywa na Google hakurikijwe Politiki y'Ibanga ya Google.
  • Microsoft Clarity: itangira gukora iyo utangiye gukoresha paji. Clarity yandika ibikorwa nko gukanda no kumanura paji (scroll) kugira ngo hakorwe amakarita y'ubushyuhe (heatmaps) n'amashusho y'uko paji yakoreshejwe (session recordings), kandi ihisha ibyo wandika mu myanya yo kwandikamo. Amakuru atunganywa na Microsoft hakurikijwe Itangazo rya Microsoft ryerekeye Ibanga.

Ushobora kwanga isesengura ubuza cookies z'ibigo byo hanze mu igenamiterere rya mushakisha yawe, ukoresha igikoresho kibuza ikurikiranwa (tracker blocker), cyangwa ushyiraho Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on. Urubuga rukomeza gukoreshwa byuzuye.

Serivisi z'abandi

  • Cloudflare, Inc. itanga serivisi yo kwakira urubuga (hosting). Seriveri zayo zishobora kuba hanze ya Indoneziya.
  • jsDelivr itanga moteri ihindura amashusho n'amajwi. Iyo moteri imanurwa muri mushakisha yawe ubwa mbere uhinduye amashusho cyangwa amajwi, bityo aderesi yawe ya IP ikagaragarira jsDelivr. Dosiye zawe ntizoherezwa.
  • Google Fonts ikoreshwa mu kwerekana inyandiko zimwe (urugero, Icyarabu, Igitayi, cyangwa Ikiyapani). Iyo imyandikire ifunguwe, aderesi yawe ya IP igaragarira Google.
  • Utubuto two gusangiza (WhatsApp, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Telegram) tuvugana n'izo serivisi gusa iyo udukanzeho.

Umutekano no gusangiza amakuru

Imihuza yose n'uru rubuga ikoresha HTTPS. Ntitugurisha, ntidukodesha, kandi ntiducuruza amakuru bwite. Amakuru asangizwa gusa abatanga serivisi bavuzwe haruguru, mu rugero rukenewe kugira ngo urubuga rukore, cyangwa iyo amategeko abisaba.

Abana

Iyi serivisi ntigenewe abana bari munsi y'imyaka 13, kandi ntidukusanya tubigambiriye amakuru bwite y'abana.

Uburenganzira bwawe

Hakurikijwe Itegeko rya Indoneziya No. 27 ryo mu 2022 rirengera amakuru bwite, ufite uburenganzira bwo gusaba kubona, gukosora, cyangwa gusiba amakuru yawe bwite, ndetse no kwisubiraho ku ruhushya watanze rwo kuyatunganya. Kubera ko hafi ya nta makuru tubika akumenyekanisha, ibyifuzo byinshi bishobora gukemurwa no gusiba amakuru y'urubuga mu igenamiterere rya mushakisha yawe. Ku bindi byifuzo, twandikire.

Impinduka kuri iyi politiki

Iyi politiki ishobora kuvugururwa igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Impinduka zitangira gukurikizwa iyo zimaze gutangazwa kuri iyi paji, itariki itangira gukurikizwa ikagaragara hejuru.

Twandikire

Ibibazo byerekeye iyi politiki bishobora koherezwa binyuze ku murongo wo kutwandikira uri hasi kuri buri paji cyangwa kuri abidhanan.my.id.
terms.title: Amategeko & Amabwiriza
terms.description: Amategeko n'amabwiriza yo gukoresha I Need Convert, igikoresho cy'ubuntu cyo guhindura dosiye muri mushakisha.
terms.body:
Ukoresheje I Need Convert (ineedconvert.com), uba wemeye aya mategeko n'amabwiriza akurikira. Niba utabyemera, turakwinginze ntukoreshe iyi serivisi.

Ibyerekeye serivisi

I Need Convert ni igikoresho cy'ubuntu cyo guhindura dosiye ziva mu buryo (format) bumwe zijya mu bundi. Ihindura rikorerwa muri mushakisha yawe, bityo dosiye ntizoherezwa kuri seriveri zacu. I Need Convert ntifitanye isano, ntishyigikiwe, kandi ntikorana na Apple, Microsoft, Google, Adobe, cyangwa undi nyir'uburyo cyangwa ikirango uwo ari we wese. Ibirango by'ubucuruzi byose ni ibya ba nyirabyo.

Imikoreshereze yemewe

  • Hindura gusa dosiye ari izawe, izo ufitiye uruhushya rwo gukoresha, cyangwa izemewe gukoreshwa hakurikijwe amategeko akurikizwa.
  • Ushobora gukoresha iyi serivisi ku mpamvu zawe bwite cyangwa iz'akazi, igihe cyose byubahiriza aya mategeko.

Dosiye zawe n'inshingano zawe

Dosiye uhindura zikomeza kuba izawe cyangwa iz'uzifiteho uburenganzira. Ni wowe ufite inshingano zuzuye ku dosiye uhitamo no ku buryo ukoresha ibyavuye mu ihindura. Buri gihe bika kopi ya dosiye y'umwimerere mbere yo kuyihindura.

Ibibujijwe

  • Guhindura cyangwa gukwirakwiza ibintu binyuranyije n'amategeko, uburenganzira bw'umuhanzi, cyangwa ubuzima bwite bw'abandi.
  • Gukoresha iyi serivisi mu kurenga uburinzi bwo kwigana (DRM) cyangwa izindi mbogamizi za tekiniki.
  • Gukoresha bot, script, cyangwa uburyo bwikora mu kugera kuri serivisi ku bwinshi.
  • Kubangamira, kuremereza, cyangwa kugerageza kumena umutekano w'urubuga na serivisi zacu.

Ibivuye mu ihindura

Duharanira ko ibivuye mu ihindura biba byiza uko bishoboka kose, ariko si uburyo bwose bushobora guhindurwa nta makemwa. Imiterere y'urupapuro, amafoto, imbonerahamwe, formula, metadata, cyangwa ubuziranenge bishobora guhinduka cyangwa kubura, bitewe n'uburyo bw'inkomoko n'ubwo bijyanwamo. Genzura ibyavuyemo mbere yo kubikoresha ku bintu by'ingenzi.

Kuboneka kwa serivisi

Serivisi itangwa ku buntu kandi ishobora guhindurwa, kugabanywa, cyangwa guhagarikwa igihe icyo ari cyo cyose nta nteguza. Uburyo bumwe bushingiye ku bushobozi bwa mushakisha n'igikoresho cyawe, bityo si ihindura ryose riboneka buri gihe.

Kwitandukanya n'ingwate

Serivisi itangwa "uko iri" kandi "uko iboneka", nta ngwate iyo ari yo yose, harimo n'ingwate y'uko serivisi izahora ikora, itarimo amakosa, cyangwa ikwiriye intego runaka.

Imbibi z'inshingano

Mu rugero amategeko yemera, ntitwishingira igihombo icyo ari cyo cyose, cyaba icy'ako kanya cyangwa kitaziguye, gituruka ku ikoreshwa ry'iyi serivisi, harimo gutakaza cyangwa kwangirika kw'amakuru na dosiye.

Imiyoboro ijya ku bandi

Uru rubuga rurimo imiyoboro ijya ku mbuga na serivisi by'abandi. Ntitwishingira ibikubiye kuri izo mbuga cyangwa politiki zazo.

Impinduka ku mategeko

Aya mategeko n'amabwiriza ashobora kuvugururwa igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Ukomeje gukoresha serivisi nyuma y'uko impinduka zitangajwe, ufatwa nk'uwemeye verisiyo iheruka.

Amategeko agenga

Aya mategeko n'amabwiriza agengwa n'amategeko ya Repubulika ya Indoneziya.

Twandikire

Ibibazo na raporo bishobora koherezwa binyuze ku murongo wo kutwandikira uri hasi kuri buri paji cyangwa kuri abidhanan.my.id. Soma kandi Politiki y'Ibanga yacu.
